name: Hanayaka Nari, Waga Ichizoku Kinema Mosaic
original_name: 華ヤカ哉、我ガ一族 キネマモザイク
source:
Kinema Mosaic takes place one year after the original Hanayaka Nari, Waga Ichizoku. None of the six Miyanomori brothers made it to become the new head of the family, and so Genichirou is holding the competition again this year. In addition, he also takes the seventh brother to live with them in the mansion — Mamoru. 
There are three modes in Kinema Mosaic: “second year mode", “epilogue mode” and “informant mode”.

[From [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2012/01/05/hanayaka-nari-waga-ichizoku-kinema-mosaic/]Love-colored Sky[/url]]
translation:
《华丽一族》本篇一年后，故事发生在这里。宫之杜家的六兄弟没有任何一人当选新的家主，因此玄一郎今年再次举办了竞争。此外，他还把第七个弟弟守接到宅邸与大家一起生活。

《Kinema Mosaic》包含三种模式：“第二年模式”、“尾声模式”与“情报提供者模式”。

[引自[url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2012/01/05/hanayaka-nari-waga-ichizoku-kinema-mosaic/]Love-colored Sky[/url]]
